samples.name: Merchandising Assortment & Category Adoption Telemetry Blind Spot
samples.description: In Merchandising, Assortment & Category AI, forecasting AI fails when the vendor reports usage but not whether merchants, store teams, operators, or finance users accepted or reversed recommendations across category planning, assortment, item setup, vendor funding, and margin controls. The mechanism is actionable because NIST AI RMF, field adoption telemetry, and finance-owned value reconciliation are not bound to the workflow before SAP or a startup tool is scaled. Intelligence should surface the evidence gap for Apex Retail, Moves should create a adoption telemetry dashboard with decision-acceptance and override reason codes, Source should require a adoption telemetry API, export rights, and BAFO acceptance criterion, and Tower should track the resulting portfolio pressure signal.
